description:
The "Session Tree" header in our /tree overlay is a plain string. Upstream renders it with dashed border separator lines above and below the header block.

## Upstream rendering

```
─── Session Tree ──────────────────────────────── (dashed line spanning full width)
↑/↓: move. ←/→: page. ... (hints)
Type to search:
(entries)
─────────────────────────────────────────────────  (dashed bottom border)
(0/0)
```

## Current rendering

```
Session Tree                    (plain string, no borders)
↑/↓: move. ←/→: page. ...
Type to search:
(entries)
(2/2)
```

## Where to fix

`apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/tree_selector.ex`, `render/2`:
- Replace `"Session Tree"` with a dashed border line containing the title centered or left-aligned
- Add a closing dashed border line after the count badge, or rely on the overlay frame for the bottom border

The exact styling depends on whether opi-iu9.13 (full-width overlay) is landed first, since border width depends on terminal width being available to render/2.

Blocked by: opi-iu9.13 (full-width overlay needed to know the border width)

## Verification

Open /tree and confirm "Session Tree" appears with dashed separator lines above and below the header block.
title: /tree header: bordered Session Tree title with dashed separator lines
